hotels.title: Contemporary Western Sydney Stay at Novotel Sydney West HQ
hotels.description: Set in Western Sydney’s buzzing West HQ precinct, this polished retreat places dining, entertainment and leisure under one roof. Sydney Coliseum Theatre sits steps away for headline performances, while nearby Eat Street serves everything from refined Japanese at CHU Restaurant by China Doll to premium steaks at Steak & Oyster Co. A short drive leads to Featherdale Sydney Wildlife Park and the walking trails of Western Sydney Parklands. Back at the hotel, guests have access to a sleek indoor pool, a contemporary fitness centre and spacious rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the district
